title: no-oversized-prod-ec2
text: EC2 instances in the production environment must not exceed 8 vCPUs / 32GB RAM without platform_owner approval, to control cost and blast radius.

title: right-sized-dev-instances
text: Development and staging EC2 instances must use burstable instance families (t3, t4g), not compute-optimized or memory-optimized families, to control non-production spend.

title: encrypt-at-rest
text: All EBS volumes, RDS instances, and S3 buckets must have encryption at rest enabled using AWS KMS-managed keys.

title: encrypt-in-transit
text: All load balancers and API gateways must enforce TLS 1.2 or higher. Plaintext HTTP listeners are prohibited except for health check endpoints.

title: no-public-s3
text: S3 buckets must not have public read or write ACLs, and public bucket policies are prohibited except for buckets explicitly tagged public-content=true.

title: restrict-ssh-rdp-cidr
text: Security groups must not allow inbound SSH (port 22) or RDP (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0. Access must be restricted to the corporate VPN CIDR range.

title: elevated-approval-cost-threshold
text: Any single Terraform apply estimated to add more than $500/month in recurring cost requires sign-off from a user with the approver role, not just operator.

title: resource-naming-convention
text: All cloud resources must be named using the pattern {org_slug}-{environment}-{resource_type}-{purpose}, lowercase, hyphen-separated, with no consecutive hyphens.

title: production-deployment-window
text: Production infrastructure changes are only permitted Monday through Thursday, 09:00-16:00 org-local time, except for emergency rollback operations approved by an on-call platform_owner.
